title: Sixteen Oregon State gymnasts named WCGA Scholastic All-Americans
text:
Sixteen Oregon State gymnasts named WCGA Scholastic All-Americans
N. E. Powers
Sixteen Oregon State University gymnasts were named Women's Collegiate Gymnastics Association (WCGA) Scholastic All-Americans, according to an Aug. 26 announcement from the university.
The WCGA recognizes collegiate gymnasts for their academic accomplishments each season. To qualify as a WCGA Scholastic All-American, student-athletes must achieve either a 3.5 overall grade point average or a 3.5 GPA for the previous school year.
Oregon State ranked No. 24 among 86 institutions in terms of the percentage of athletes earning recognition, with over 84% of its roster—16 student-athletes—receiving the honor. The gymnastics team posted a combined GPA of 3.58.
This marks the eighth consecutive season that at least 14 Oregon State gymnasts have been recognized by the WCGA for their academic achievements.
The student-athletes named as WCGA Scholastic All-Americans are Olivia Buckner, Francesca Caso, Kaylee Cheek, Taylor DeVries, Sophia Esposito, Giulianna Fiorillo, Mia Heather, Sophia Kaloudis, Lauren Letzsch, Reina Marchal, Jennifer McMillan, Savannah Miller, Katie Rude, Giavanna Tatone, Paulina Vargas, and Ellie Weaver.
